Extractive

extractive summaries, however it tends to
drift toward abstractive summaries
Abstractive

the key points and relationships, and gener-
ates a summary that conveys the essential
meaning in its own words
 Can rephrase ideas, use synonyms, and
change the sentence structure
 Can incorporate the overall sentiment or tone
of the original text, or change it on demand
according to the needs

inference
